integrity: An analytic proof is supplied together with exact rational computation and separately seeded Monte Carlo diagnostics. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
limitations: Uniform Dirichlet spacings only; no nonuniform or unequal-shape extension. General ordered-spacing densities potentially yield the joint moment by integration; earlier explicit evaluation cannot be excluded. Rao–Sobel (1980) serves as supporting comparison literature, not as the primary Gini-spacings research seed.
title: Exact maximum–Gini dependence for uniform spacings
